Class ViewLessonDetail

java.lang.Object
guiLessonDetail.ViewLessonDetail
public class ViewLessonDetail extends Object

Title: ViewLessonDetail Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Lesson Detail Page. A contributor opens one of their lessons from My Lessons to examine it more closely (Contributor story 2), edit it, or delete it (Contributor story 1, "I can see and manage it"). Fields a curator has locked are shown but cannot be changed, and are labeled "Locked by a curator"; a lesson with any lock cannot be deleted, and the page says why (Contributor story 2). A lesson a curator has edited shows an "Edited by curator" tag (Contributor story 4). Deleting asks "Are you sure?", naming the lesson, with No as the default.

The layout matches the Add Lesson page, which follows the team's User Experience document, so the two forms look the same; Delete is the red button the document reserves for deleting.

  • Method Details

    • displayLessonDetail

      public static void displayLessonDetail(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: displayLessonDetail(Stage ps, User user, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: This method is the single entry point from outside this package to cause the Lesson Detail page to be displayed for the lesson selected on My Lessons. The lesson is read again from the database by its ID, so the page shows its latest values and lock state. If it no longer exists, the contributor is returned to My Lessons with the not-found message instead.

      Parameters:
      ps - specifies the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and it's methods
      user - specifies the User for this GUI and it's methods
      lesson - specifies the lesson that was selected on the My Lessons page

    • styleAllInputs

      protected static void styleAllInputs()

      Method: styleAllInputs()

      Description: Gives every input the bordered field look, with a gray background on locked fields so the contributor can see at a glance which ones cannot be changed. The Controller calls this after it sets each field's lock state.
